hero.title: ATEX-certified solutions for <accent>confidence in every environment.</accent>
hero.lead: From cable glands to combination boxes and lighting: explosion-proof products for explosive gas and dust atmospheres.

intro.statement: Starting from Kocaeli, we serve critical industrial facilities all around the world.
intro.body: By combining quality and durability in explosion-proof products and electrical equipment with on-time delivery and technical support, we help your operations run safely and without interruption.

glands.name: Cable glands
glands.title: Explosion-proof and weatherproof cable glands
glands.lead: We offer a wide range of cable glands for different cable types and installation conditions.
glands.body: Made in every size from M10 to M110 and in materials from brass to stainless steel, our ATEX-certified cable glands are designed for a long service life.

combination.name: Combination boxes
combination.title: Explosion-proof combination boxes
combination.lead: Our combination boxes are shipped to site fully equipped and ready to use.
combination.body:
Internal switchgear and wiring come fully assembled, together with cable glands, plugs and sockets.
You choose the current ratings and the number of plugs and sockets, and we tailor single-phase and three-phase distribution to your needs.

lighting.name: Lighting
lighting.title: Explosion-proof lighting
lighting.lead: Our luminaires are designed for lighting in explosive gas and dust atmospheres.
lighting.body: Used in hazardous areas covered by Zone 1, Zone 2, Zone 21 and Zone 22, these luminaires offer high luminous efficacy, energy savings and a long service life with LED technology.

guide.body: Zone classes, what Ex marking means and what to check when choosing a product are all in the knowledge center.

closing.title: The right product, at the right time, in full.
closing.note: Which product is used in which area must be determined by competent experts based on the site's Zone classification.
